title: Basic Earnings Per Share
description: Calculate basic EPS using income available to common shareholders and weighted-average common shares.
html:
What is Basic EPS?

Basic earnings per share measures income available to common shareholders for each weighted-average common share outstanding during the period.

Basic EPS = (Net Income − Preferred Dividends) ÷ Weighted-Average Common Shares Outstanding

Simple example

Assume:

Net Income $500,000
Preferred Dividends $20,000
Weighted-Average Common Shares 120,000

Income available to common shareholders

$500,000 − $20,000 = $480,000

Basic EPS

$480,000 ÷ 120,000 = $4.00 per share

Why weighted-average shares?

The number of shares outstanding can change during the year. Therefore, shares are generally weighted according to the portion of the reporting period they were outstanding.

Weighted-average example

Assume 100,000 common shares are outstanding on January 1.

On July 1, the company issues another 40,000 shares.

Original shares

100,000 × 12/12 = 100,000

New shares

40,000 × 6/12 = 20,000

Weighted-average shares

100,000 + 20,000 = 120,000

Important

Do not automatically use ending shares outstanding in the EPS denominator.

Shares issued or reacquired during the period generally must be time-weighted.

Stock splits and stock dividends

Stock splits and certain stock dividends require special treatment in EPS calculations.

The related share amounts are generally reflected retrospectively for EPS purposes as though the change had occurred at the beginning of the earliest period presented.

Simple stock split idea

If a 2-for-1 stock split occurs, each old share becomes two shares.

EPS share data must be adjusted so periods are presented on a comparable basis.

Basic EPS checklist

  1. Start with net income.
  2. Adjust for applicable preferred dividends.
  3. Calculate weighted-average common shares.
  4. Account properly for stock splits or stock dividends.
  5. Divide numerator by denominator.

quiz.prompt: A company reports net income of $360,000 and preferred dividends of $20,000. Weighted-average common shares outstanding are 85,000. What is basic EPS?
quiz.explanation: Income available to common shareholders = $360,000 − $20,000 = $340,000. Basic EPS = $340,000 ÷ 85,000 = $4.00.
